description: This file contains Makefile snippets and macros related to building and managing root filesystem images, including conditional definitions for mklibs, opkg, apk, and functions for cleaning and preparing root filesystems.

methods.name: mklibs
methods.description: Macro to build a list of dynamically linked libraries and programs, strip them, and copy to a target directory.

methods.name: opkg
methods.description: Macro to define the command for managing IPKG packages with specific options.

methods.name: apk
methods.description: Macro to define the command for managing APK packages with specific options.

methods.name: clean_ipkg
methods.description: Function to clean up opkg package info and status files.

methods.name: prepare_rootfs
methods.description: Function to prepare root filesystem, run post-install scripts, clean up version control directories, and invoke mklibs and clean functions.
